cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James's independent advisor recruiting page frames its value proposition as "a partnership in independence," offering independent contractors access to the firm's full capabilities at a level right for their business.
items.quote: A partnership in independence. Standing apart doesn't mean you need to stand alone. When you affiliate with Raymond James as an independent contractor, you can access our full capabilities at a level that's right for your business.

items.text: The independent advisor page describes "Powerful independence" — the ability to serve clients and grow an independent practice without wanting for capability, expert insight or client resources, with everything the firm has available on demand.
items.quote: Powerful independence. Serve your clients and grow your independent practice without wanting for capability, expert insight or client resources. Everything we have is yours when you want it.

items.text: The independent advisor page describes enjoying the rewards of running one's own practice with the support of a full-service, self-clearing NYSE-member broker/dealer, spanning investing, planning, private wealth, marketing and technology.
items.quote: Enjoy the rewards of running your own practice with the support of a full-service, self-clearing New York Stock Exchange-member broker/dealer. Investing, planning, private wealth, marketing, technology – it's all there.

items.text: CEO Paul Shoukry describes the value proposition as a unique combination of an advisor- and client-focused culture coupled with leading technology and solutions, which combined with a strong balance sheet and commitment to independence is a differentiator for advisors evaluating alternatives.
items.quote: We offer a unique combination of an advisor and client-focused culture, coupled with leading technology and solutions. This value proposition, coupled with our strong balance sheet and commitment to independence, is proving to be a differentiator for advisors evaluating alternatives.

items.text: Shoukry describes the firm's "best of both worlds" value proposition — a unique combination of advisor- and client-focused culture coupled with leading technology and solutions — as resonating with advisors across all affiliation options, with the strong balance sheet and commitment to independence increasingly a differentiator.
items.quote: Our best of both worlds value proposition, where we offer a unique combination of an advisor and client-focused culture, coupled with leading technology and solutions, continues to resonate with advisors across all of our affiliation options.

items.text: Shoukry states that advisors do not have to choose between culture and capabilities — Raymond James offers a unique combination of an advisor- and client-focused culture together with leading technologies, products and solutions, plus a strong balance sheet, long-term thinking and commitment to independence.
items.quote: At Raymond James, advisers do not have to choose between culture and capabilities. We offer a unique combination of an adviser and client-focused culture together with leading technologies, products and solutions advisers need to serve clients at a high level. Combined with our strong balance sheet, long-term thinking and commitment to independence, that continues to set Raymond James apart.

items.text: The affiliation options page describes "The Power of Choice" — AdvisorChoice lets advisors match their goals to an affiliation option offering a unique combination of support, freedom and flexibility, backed by a leading independent financial firm.
items.quote: Through AdvisorChoice®, you have the ability to match your professional goals to the affiliation option that's right for you, each offering a unique combination of support, freedom and flexibility – and all backed by the full support of a leading independent financial firm.

items.text: Shoukry describes the "powerfully personal" value proposition released with the firm's annual report — focusing on personal relationships with financial advisors and giving them tools to strengthen relationships with clients — as increasingly differentiating and resonating with existing and prospective advisors.
items.quote: The powerfully personal, the value proposition that we released with our annual report, several weeks ago, is increasingly differentiating as well.

items.text: Shoukry describes a stable, long-term platform as what resonates most with advisors — Raymond James's best-of-both-worlds value proposition (advisor/client-focused culture and long-term client-first values coupled with resources, platform, technology, products and services) versus short-term, levered players in an industry with M&A consolidation.
items.quote: What's resonating with advisors is what has always resonated here at Raymond James, which is our best-of-both-worlds value proposition... Having a stable platform like Raymond James, where they have confidence that their business, their employees, their team, and most importantly, their clients will have a stable platform for the long-term, is really what resonates the most.

items.text: The investor-day deck quotes advisors describing the firm's culture of promoting independence and putting advisors and clients first, along with world-class technology that creates capacity and frees time to spend with clients.
items.quote: The firm's long-standing culture of promoting independence and putting advisors and their clients first is an ideal fit for our practice. Additionally, we've gained access to world-class technology that will help create capacity and free more time to spend face-to-face with clients.

cells.reason: Multiple passages directly describe Raymond James's value proposition to advisors, including its dedicated independent-advisor recruiting page and CEO statements, so these are facts.
